Exo design system

One source for the look of every Exo app: tokens/tokens.json renders exo.css for the web and exo_tokens.rs for GPUI. This page is generated from the same tokens.

Liquid Glass

Clear and toned over what is behind, one even line round it. Each sits on the same bright backdrop.

SmallControls, capsules, the mini player.
LargeSheets, notices, popovers, the overlay and a raised shadow.
MenuA menu is large glass; its rows lift 34px.
PaneA side panel under its content.
PlateWords over art: the art held down further.

Type

Geist, three sizes for most of the app: 20 titles, 13 body and controls, 12 small. Controls are medium; section names and titles are semibold.

Title 20 semibold
Page 28
Control 13 medium
Body 13 regular, what the row says.
Small 12 medium
Label 10 medium
Tabular 0123456789 111 111

Controls

Buttons, a field, a switch and a card, built from the same glass and motion tokens.

Card

A card is 14px, the glass of a menu. A cover lifts 3px on hover.

Row
Second row
Cover

Icons

Tabler outline, a 1.875 line on its 24 grid: 1.25px at 16px, so it reads as the 13px labels do.

Motion

Eight named motions, each playable below. Two curves: what appears eases out; what travels or changes shape springs (damped, never overshoots). Under Reduce motion nothing slides, grows, springs or loops.

MotionKindChannels (property, from→to, duration)Reduced
pressstate · on activescale 1→0.97 · 90msno motion, the change lands at once
hover-liftstate · on hovertranslateY 0→-3 · 120ms; brightness 1→1.06 · 120msbrightness (120ms), brightness (120ms)
page-enterenteropacity 0→1 · 160ms; translateX 12→0 · 260msopacity (160ms), opacity (120ms)
card-morphenterflip 1→0 · 260msno motion, the change lands at once
list-staggerenteropacity 0→1 · 280ms; translateY 8→0 · 280msopacity (160ms)
sheetenterscale 0.98→1 · 260msopacity (160ms), opacity (120ms)
toastentertranslateY -8→0 · 160msno motion, the change lands at once
progressenterscaleX 0→1 · 300ms; translateXPercent -100→100 · 1600ms; translateXPercent -100→300 · 1400msscaleX (0ms)
